items.followUp: What information should be identified when defining a problem for a computer program?

rubric.why: A problem must be understood before a suitable solution can be planned.
rubric.description: Explain that defining a problem begins by understanding it clearly.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that the problem must be understood or clearly identified.

rubric.why: The required input data is part of identifying what the problem involves.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for mentioning the input.

rubric.why: The operations needed to solve the problem must be determined.
rubric.description: Identify the processing or operations required.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for mentioning the processing or operations.

rubric.why: The required result must be specified so the solution has a clear goal.
rubric.description: Identify the expected output or result.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for mentioning the output or result.

modelAnswer: Defining a problem means clearly understanding what problem has to be solved.
Determine the processing or operations needed to solve the problem.
Specify the expected output or result.

items.followUp: Give two examples of sensitive information that encryption can help protect when using the internet.

rubric.why: Encryption encodes readable information so it requires the correct key to be understood.
rubric.description: Explain that encryption encodes data and requires a key to read it.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for describing encoded data or the role of a key.

rubric.why: Keeping communications private is a key everyday purpose of encryption.
rubric.description: Explain that encryption protects privacy or confidentiality.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that it keeps information private or confidential.

rubric.why: Passwords and financial information are examples of sensitive data people send online.
rubric.description: Give an example of sensitive information protected by encryption.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for a relevant example such as passwords or payment or banking details.

rubric.why: Encryption helps protect data during common internet activities from unauthorized reading.
rubric.description: Connect encryption to safer online activity or preventing unauthorized reading.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for linking encryption to a safer online activity or protection from unauthorized reading.

modelAnswer: Encryption converts readable data into an encoded form that cannot be understood without the correct key.
It protects the privacy of information sent over the internet from unauthorized reading.
It helps safeguard sensitive information such as passwords and payment or banking details.
This makes activities such as online banking and shopping safer.
